name: dsh-hold-to-talk
description: Fork of dsh-hold-to-talk: hold the mouse on the DSH Web composer, speak, release to insert. Local SenseVoice or ANY third-party ASR (OpenAI-compatible / chat-audio), plus user wordbank (术语表 + 纠正规则), prompt context from the composer draft, and a Settings page. 在原版长按语音输入基础上加了:云端 ASR、用户词库、输入框草稿作提示词、设置页。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/model-cache.js && node --check lib/asr-worker.mjs && node --check lib/cloud-asr.mjs && node --check lib/realtime-asr.mjs && node --check lib/wordbank.mjs && node --check lib/settings-store.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node tools/client-smoke.mjs && node tools/host-test.mjs && node tools/client-test.mjs

author: wangzhanchao883 (original author); lcx19970714 (fork maintainer)

changes: lib/cloud-asr.mjs: 第三方 ASR 转发(transcriptions / chat-audio 两种协议,支持 system 提示词)
lib/wordbank.mjs: 用户词库解析(术语表 + 纠正规则)与本地结果后处理
lib/index.js: 云端分支、提示词合成、草稿上下文、/settings 路由、热更新
lib/client.js: 松手时把输入框草稿作为上下文发送;设置 → 语音输入 页
lib/index.js + client.js: 云端实时预览(interim 走云端尾部窗口,浮层边说边出字)
lib/realtime-asr.mjs + index.js/client.js: 真流式 WebSocket(默认关,设置页可切换)
